I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** On Oct 13, in #central-random (a channel Tobias is in), he posted that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** That thread calls it "Tobias's dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks by name. I told him to check it's the same account before he puts it in the notes.
- **A similar number:** I also pointed out that #88412 is a different, older ticket, for Tansleigh Packaging's Door 6 scanner, so the two don't get mixed up.

Earlier, in a direct message, Tobias guessed the ticket would end up as a different number and asked me to keep that guess private. I left it out of the channel reply. It's a guess, not a real ticket.
